headline: Ministry of Economy and Finance - Ministry of Environment and Energy: Specification of the €95 Million Support for Greek Industry
summary: Greece's Ministry of Economy and Finance and Ministry of Environment and Energy set a maximum fiscal ceiling of €95 million for industrial support. The measure awaits approval from the European Commission's competition directorate.
why: State aid to industry in EU member states must be cleared by the European Commission's competition directorate, which can shape the timing and scale of national support programmes for companies.
